Multi English · 5th Grade · Theme 2

Vocabulary Quiz

Test 1 / 3
Cevaplanan: 0 / 50

Doğru şıkkı işaretle. Cevabını değiştirebilirsin. Bitirince altta TESTİ BİTİR düğmesine bas. Menü ile başka bir teste geçebilirsin.

1Vocabulary Test 1 · Read each paragraph. Choose the correct word to complete the blank.

1

Ece brings paints and brushes to school. She draws pictures and uses many colours in this lesson. Her subject is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) Art

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ece brings paints and brushes to school. She draws pictures and uses many colours in this lesson.” Bu tarif “Art” kelimesine uyar; Art = görsel sanatlar, resim. Diğer şıklar: I.T. (bilişim teknolojileri), English (İngilizce), Maths (matematik).

2

Selin learns about plants, animals and light. Her class also does simple experiments. This subject is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) Science

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Selin learns about plants, animals and light. Her class also does simple experiments.” Bu tarif “Science” kelimesine uyar; Science = fen bilimleri. Diğer şıklar: P.E. (beden eğitimi), Turkish (Türkçe), Drama (drama).

3

Duru sings with her classmates. They learn songs and play instruments in this lesson. Their subject is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) Music

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Duru sings with her classmates. They learn songs and play instruments in this lesson.” Bu tarif “Music” kelimesine uyar; Music = müzik. Diğer şıklar: Elective Lesson (seçmeli ders), Religion and Morals (din kültürü ve ahlak bilgisi), Maths (matematik).

4

Elif learns about society and the places where people live. Her teacher also talks about history and maps. This subject is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) Social Studies

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Elif learns about society and the places where people live. Her teacher also talks about history and maps.” Bu tarif “Social Studies” kelimesine uyar; Social Studies = sosyal bilgiler. Diğer şıklar: Turkish (Türkçe), P.E. (beden eğitimi), Drama (drama).

5

Nehir starts her school week after Sunday. This is her first school day of the week. It is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) Monday

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Nehir starts her school week after Sunday. This is her first school day of the week.” Bu tarif “Monday” kelimesine uyar; Monday = Pazartesi. Diğer şıklar: Saturday (Cumartesi), noon (öğle vakti), weekend (hafta sonu).

6

Sena has art the day after Tuesday. The following day is Thursday. She has art on ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) Wednesday

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sena has art the day after Tuesday. The following day is Thursday.” Bu tarif “Wednesday” kelimesine uyar; Wednesday = Çarşamba. Diğer şıklar: Thursday (Perşembe), morning (sabah), o'clock (tam saat).

7

İpek has science on the last day of the school week. The following day is Saturday. She has science on ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) Friday

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İpek has science on the last day of the school week. The following day is Saturday.” Bu tarif “Friday” kelimesine uyar; Friday = Cuma. Diğer şıklar: break (teneffüs, ara), weekday (hafta içi), quarter to (çeyrek kala).

8

Eylül visits her cousins the day after Saturday. The following day is Monday. She visits them on ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) Sunday

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eylül visits her cousins the day after Saturday. The following day is Monday.” Bu tarif “Sunday” kelimesine uyar; Sunday = Pazar. Diğer şıklar: Tuesday (Salı), afternoon (öğleden sonra), quarter past (çeyrek geçe).

9

Cemre's break starts at 9:30. It is thirty minutes after nine. We say ______ nine.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) half past

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cemre's break starts at 9:30. It is thirty minutes after nine.” Bu tarif “half past” kelimesine uyar; half past = buçuk. Diğer şıklar: lunch break (öğle yemeği arası), Saturday (Cumartesi), Wednesday (Çarşamba).

10

Melis leaves home at 8:45. It is fifteen minutes before nine. We say ______ nine.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) quarter to

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Melis leaves home at 8:45. It is fifteen minutes before nine.” Bu tarif “quarter to” kelimesine uyar; quarter to = çeyrek kala. Diğer şıklar: quarter past (çeyrek geçe), o'clock (tam saat), noon (öğle vakti).

11

Sıla has a tall piece of furniture in her room. It has several shelves full of books. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) bookcase

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sıla has a tall piece of furniture in her room. It has several shelves full of books.” Bu tarif “bookcase” kelimesine uyar; bookcase = kitaplık. Diğer şıklar: desk (sıra, masa), poster (afiş, poster), pencil case (kalem kutusu).

12

Defne colours a picture. She uses a coloured wax stick instead of a pencil. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) crayon

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Defne colours a picture. She uses a coloured wax stick instead of a pencil.” Bu tarif “crayon” kelimesine uyar; crayon = pastel boya. Diğer şıklar: rubbish bin (çöp kutusu), board marker (tahta kalemi), ruler (cetvel).

13

Buse does not know an English word. She checks a book with words and their meanings. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) dictionary

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Buse does not know an English word. She checks a book with words and their meanings.” Bu tarif “dictionary” kelimesine uyar; dictionary = sözlük. Diğer şıklar: smart board (akıllı tahta), glue (yapıştırıcı), clock (duvar saati).

14

İdil writes her lesson notes on lined pages. The pages are together in a small book with a cover. It is her ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) notebook

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İdil writes her lesson notes on lined pages. The pages are together in a small book with a cover.” Bu tarif “notebook” kelimesine uyar; notebook = defter. Diğer şıklar: school bag (okul çantası), rubber (silgi), scissors (makas).

15

Zeynep sees a large printed picture on the wall. It has a message about keeping the classroom clean. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) poster

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Zeynep sees a large printed picture on the wall. It has a message about keeping the classroom clean.” Bu tarif “poster” kelimesine uyar; poster = afiş, poster. Diğer şıklar: timetable (ders programı), smart board (akıllı tahta), dictionary (sözlük).

16

Mina finishes a snack. She puts the empty wrapper in the correct container. This container is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) rubbish bin

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Mina finishes a snack. She puts the empty wrapper in the correct container.” Bu tarif “rubbish bin” kelimesine uyar; rubbish bin = çöp kutusu. Diğer şıklar: board marker (tahta kalemi), bookcase (kitaplık), notebook (defter).

17

Pelin takes her books to school. She carries them in a bag on her back. It is her ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) school bag

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Pelin takes her books to school. She carries them in a bag on her back.” Bu tarif “school bag” kelimesine uyar; school bag = okul çantası. Diğer şıklar: pencil case (kalem kutusu), desk (sıra, masa), scissors (makas).

18

Derya's teacher shows a video to the class. She touches a large electronic classroom screen. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) smart board

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Derya's teacher shows a video to the class. She touches a large electronic classroom screen.” Bu tarif “smart board” kelimesine uyar; smart board = akıllı tahta. Diğer şıklar: ruler (cetvel), timetable (ders programı), clock (duvar saati).

19

Sena gets up at seven and eats breakfast. She does this before noon each day. She has breakfast in the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) morning

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sena gets up at seven and eats breakfast. She does this before noon each day.” Bu tarif “morning” kelimesine uyar; morning = sabah. Diğer şıklar: Friday (Cuma), Sunday (Pazar), weekday (hafta içi).

20

Eda finishes lunch at one. Her next lesson starts at two and ends before evening. It takes place in the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) afternoon

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eda finishes lunch at one. Her next lesson starts at two and ends before evening.” Bu tarif “afternoon” kelimesine uyar; afternoon = öğleden sonra. Diğer şıklar: half past (buçuk), Thursday (Perşembe), break (teneffüs, ara).

21

Cem has no school on Saturday or Sunday. He spends these two days with his family. These days form the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) weekend

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cem has no school on Saturday or Sunday. He spends these two days with his family.” Bu tarif “weekend” kelimesine uyar; weekend = hafta sonu. Diğer şıklar: Tuesday (Salı), Monday (Pazartesi), Friday (Cuma).

22

Eren has time to eat his midday meal at school. Lessons stop while students have their food. It is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) lunch break

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eren has time to eat his midday meal at school. Lessons stop while students have their food.” Bu tarif “lunch break” kelimesine uyar; lunch break = öğle yemeği arası. Diğer şıklar: quarter to (çeyrek kala), Sunday (Pazar), weekday (hafta içi).

23

Baran has two rulers. He lets a friend use one for a lesson and gets it back later. He agrees to ______ his ruler.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) lend

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Baran has two rulers. He lets a friend use one for a lesson and gets it back later.” Bu tarif “lend” kelimesine uyar; lend = ödünç vermek. Diğer şıklar: keep clean (temiz tutmak), finish (bitirmek), show respect (saygı göstermek).

24

Tolga's desk has pens and books everywhere. He puts each thing in its correct place. He decides to ______ his desk.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) tidy up

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tolga's desk has pens and books everywhere. He puts each thing in its correct place.” Bu tarif “tidy up” kelimesine uyar; tidy up = toparlamak, düzenlemek. Diğer şıklar: hang (asmak), bring (getirmek), follow the rules (kurallara uymak).

25

Ozan cannot carry all his books. His friend offers to help him with them. His friend wants to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) give a hand

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ozan cannot carry all his books. His friend offers to help him with them.” Bu tarif “give a hand” kelimesine uyar; give a hand = yardım etmek. Diğer şıklar: look up (sözlükte kelime aramak), forget (unutmak), leave (bırakmak, ayrılmak).

2Vocabulary Test 2 · Read each paragraph. Choose the correct word to complete the blank.

1

Mert enjoys working with numbers. He adds and subtracts in this lesson. His favourite subject is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) Maths

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Mert enjoys working with numbers. He adds and subtracts in this lesson.” Bu tarif “Maths” kelimesine uyar; Maths = matematik. Diğer şıklar: Turkish (Türkçe), Music (müzik), English (İngilizce).

2

Bora puts on his sports shoes. His class runs, jumps and plays ball games in this lesson. This subject is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) P.E.

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Bora puts on his sports shoes. His class runs, jumps and plays ball games in this lesson.” Bu tarif “P.E.” kelimesine uyar; P.E. = beden eğitimi. Diğer şıklar: Social Studies (sosyal bilgiler), Religion and Morals (din kültürü ve ahlak bilgisi), Art (görsel sanatlar, resim).

3

Arda uses a computer in this lesson. He learns about keyboards and computer programs. This subject is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) I.T.

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Arda uses a computer in this lesson. He learns about keyboards and computer programs.” Bu tarif “I.T.” kelimesine uyar; I.T. = bilişim teknolojileri. Diğer şıklar: Drama (drama), Elective Lesson (seçmeli ders), Science (fen bilimleri).

4

Can learns to say hello and goodbye. He practises reading and speaking in this language lesson. This subject is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) English

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Can learns to say hello and goodbye. He practises reading and speaking in this language lesson.” Bu tarif “English” kelimesine uyar; English = İngilizce. Diğer şıklar: Art (görsel sanatlar, resim), Social Studies (sosyal bilgiler), P.E. (beden eğitimi).

5

Emir has music the day after Monday. His next school day is Wednesday. He has music on ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) Tuesday

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Emir has music the day after Monday. His next school day is Wednesday.” Bu tarif “Tuesday” kelimesine uyar; Tuesday = Salı. Diğer şıklar: half past (buçuk), lunch break (öğle yemeği arası), Friday (Cuma).

6

Baran has English the day after Wednesday. The next day is Friday. He has English on ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) Thursday

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Baran has English the day after Wednesday. The next day is Friday.” Bu tarif “Thursday” kelimesine uyar; Thursday = Perşembe. Diğer şıklar: Wednesday (Çarşamba), quarter to (çeyrek kala), morning (sabah).

7

Tolga rests on the day after Friday. The next day is Sunday. Today is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) Saturday

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tolga rests on the day after Friday. The next day is Sunday.” Bu tarif “Saturday” kelimesine uyar; Saturday = Cumartesi. Diğer şıklar: weekend (hafta sonu), break (teneffüs, ara), afternoon (öğleden sonra).

8

Ozan's lesson starts at 8:00. It is exactly eight with no extra minutes. We say eight ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) o'clock

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ozan's lesson starts at 8:00. It is exactly eight with no extra minutes.” Bu tarif “o'clock” kelimesine uyar; o'clock = tam saat. Diğer şıklar: weekday (hafta içi), Sunday (Pazar), noon (öğle vakti).

9

Yusuf has lunch at 12:15. It is fifteen minutes after twelve. We say ______ twelve.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) quarter past

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Yusuf has lunch at 12:15. It is fifteen minutes after twelve.” Bu tarif “quarter past” kelimesine uyar; quarter past = çeyrek geçe. Diğer şıklar: Monday (Pazartesi), quarter to (çeyrek kala), morning (sabah).

10

Aras writes a word on the whiteboard. He uses a special pen for this surface. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) board marker

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Aras writes a word on the whiteboard. He uses a special pen for this surface.” Bu tarif “board marker” kelimesine uyar; board marker = tahta kalemi. Diğer şıklar: notebook (defter), crayon (pastel boya), rubber (silgi).

11

Gökçe wants to know the time. She looks at the round object on the classroom wall. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) clock

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Gökçe wants to know the time. She looks at the round object on the classroom wall.” Bu tarif “clock” kelimesine uyar; clock = duvar saati. Diğer şıklar: pencil case (kalem kutusu), dictionary (sözlük), timetable (ders programı).

12

Kerem sits down for his lesson. He puts his notebook on the table in front of him. This table is his ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) desk

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Kerem sits down for his lesson. He puts his notebook on the table in front of him.” Bu tarif “desk” kelimesine uyar; desk = sıra, masa. Diğer şıklar: scissors (makas), ruler (cetvel), bookcase (kitaplık).

13

Deniz makes a paper card. He needs something sticky to attach a picture to it. He uses ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) glue

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Deniz makes a paper card. He needs something sticky to attach a picture to it.” Bu tarif “glue” kelimesine uyar; glue = yapıştırıcı. Diğer şıklar: school bag (okul çantası), rubbish bin (çöp kutusu), smart board (akıllı tahta).

14

Onur keeps his pens and pencils together. He puts them in a small container inside his bag. It is his ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) pencil case

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Onur keeps his pens and pencils together. He puts them in a small container inside his bag.” Bu tarif “pencil case” kelimesine uyar; pencil case = kalem kutusu. Diğer şıklar: poster (afiş, poster), notebook (defter), crayon (pastel boya).

15

Arda makes a mistake with his pencil. He removes the pencil mark from the page. He uses a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) rubber

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Arda makes a mistake with his pencil. He removes the pencil mark from the page.” Bu tarif “rubber” kelimesine uyar; rubber = silgi. Diğer şıklar: smart board (akıllı tahta), timetable (ders programı), rubbish bin (çöp kutusu).

16

Ali needs a straight line in his notebook. He uses a long object with centimetre marks. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) ruler

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ali needs a straight line in his notebook. He uses a long object with centimetre marks.” Bu tarif “ruler” kelimesine uyar; ruler = cetvel. Diğer şıklar: desk (sıra, masa), poster (afiş, poster), school bag (okul çantası).

17

Efe wants two small pieces of paper. He uses a tool with two blades to cut the paper. He needs ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) scissors

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Efe wants two small pieces of paper. He uses a tool with two blades to cut the paper.” Bu tarif “scissors” kelimesine uyar; scissors = makas. Diğer şıklar: bookcase (kitaplık), dictionary (sözlük), glue (yapıştırıcı).

18

Berk wants to know his lessons for each day. He checks a chart with subjects and lesson times. This chart is his ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) timetable

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Berk wants to know his lessons for each day. He checks a chart with subjects and lesson times.” Bu tarif “timetable” kelimesine uyar; timetable = ders programı. Diğer şıklar: clock (duvar saati), board marker (tahta kalemi), school bag (okul çantası).

19

Burak checks the time. It is exactly twelve in the middle of the day. It is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) noon

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Burak checks the time. It is exactly twelve in the middle of the day.” Bu tarif “noon” kelimesine uyar; noon = öğle vakti. Diğer şıklar: Friday (Cuma), weekend (hafta sonu), lunch break (öğle yemeği arası).

20

Tuna goes to school from Monday to Friday. Each of these days belongs to the school week rather than the weekend. Monday is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) weekday

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tuna goes to school from Monday to Friday. Each of these days belongs to the school week rather than the weekend.” Bu tarif “weekday” kelimesine uyar; weekday = hafta içi. Diğer şıklar: Wednesday (Çarşamba), Monday (Pazartesi), Tuesday (Salı).

21

Aylin has a short rest between two lessons. She talks to friends before the next class starts. This time is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) break

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Aylin has a short rest between two lessons. She talks to friends before the next class starts.” Bu tarif “break” kelimesine uyar; break = teneffüs, ara. Diğer şıklar: Sunday (Pazar), Thursday (Perşembe), Saturday (Cumartesi).

22

Nehir needs a pencil for one lesson. Her friend gives her one, and she returns it after class. She asks to ______ a pencil.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) borrow

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Nehir needs a pencil for one lesson. Her friend gives her one, and she returns it after class.” Bu tarif “borrow” kelimesine uyar; borrow = ödünç almak. Diğer şıklar: keep clean (temiz tutmak), hold on (beklemek, tutunmak), hang (asmak).

23

İpek sees a new word in a story. She opens her dictionary to find its meaning. She wants to ______ the word.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) look up

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İpek sees a new word in a story. She opens her dictionary to find its meaning.” Bu tarif “look up” kelimesine uyar; look up = sözlükte kelime aramak. Diğer şıklar: listen carefully (dikkatle dinlemek), finish (bitirmek), bring (getirmek).

24

Eylül does a project with three classmates. All four students share ideas and tasks. They ______ during the lesson.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) work in groups

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eylül does a project with three classmates. All four students share ideas and tasks.” Bu tarif “work in groups” kelimesine uyar; work in groups = gruplar hâlinde çalışmak. Diğer şıklar: show respect (saygı göstermek), throw rubbish (çöp atmak), lend (ödünç vermek).

25

Cemre knows the answer in class. She lifts one hand and waits for the teacher. The teacher says, "Please ______ before speaking."

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) raise your hand

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cemre knows the answer in class. She lifts one hand and waits for the teacher.” Bu tarif “raise your hand” kelimesine uyar; raise your hand = elini kaldırmak. Diğer şıklar: forget (unutmak), leave (bırakmak, ayrılmak), follow the rules (kurallara uymak).

3Vocabulary Quiz 50 · Choose the correct Turkish meaning of each word. (Her kelimenin doğru Türkçe anlamını seçiniz.)

1

Art

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) görsel sanatlar, resim

“Art” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “görsel sanatlar, resim” olur. Bu ifade “Okul dersleri” grubundandır. Örnek: We draw pictures in Art.

2

Maths

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) matematik

“Maths” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “matematik” olur. Bu ifade “Okul dersleri” grubundandır. Örnek: Maths is my favourite lesson.

3

Science

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) fen bilimleri

“Science” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “fen bilimleri” olur. Bu ifade “Okul dersleri” grubundandır. Örnek: We do experiments in Science.

4

P.E.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) beden eğitimi

“P.E.” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “beden eğitimi” olur. Bu ifade “Okul dersleri” grubundandır. Örnek: We play basketball in P.E.

5

Music

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) müzik

“Music” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “müzik” olur. Bu ifade “Okul dersleri” grubundandır. Örnek: We sing songs in Music.

6

I.T.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) bilişim teknolojileri

“I.T.” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “bilişim teknolojileri” olur. Bu ifade “Okul dersleri” grubundandır. Örnek: We use computers in I.T.

7

Social Studies

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) sosyal bilgiler

“Social Studies” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “sosyal bilgiler” olur. Bu ifade “Okul dersleri” grubundandır. Örnek: We learn about history in Social Studies.

8

English

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) İngilizce

“English” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “İngilizce” olur. Bu ifade “Okul dersleri” grubundandır. Örnek: I have English on Monday.
